description: This file defines a `DeviceIdentity` structure along with related utilities for managing device identity information, including key generation, signing payloads, and file storage management. It also includes a `DeviceIdentityPaths` enum for determining storage locations.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A Codable and Sendable structure holding device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityPaths
classes.description: An enum providing a method to determine the file system path for storing device state data based on environment variables and default directories.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads the existing device identity from disk or creates a new one if not present or invalid.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a string payload using the device's private key and returns a base64url-encoded signature.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with new keys and a device ID based on SHA256 of the public key.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into a base64 URL-safe string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the public key of the device identity in a base64 URL-safe format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the device identity to disk atomically.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL point for storing device identity data.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL for storing state data, checking environment variables and default directories.
